name: @cortexkit/opencode-magic-context
description: OpenCode plugin for Magic Context — cross-session memory and context management
author: ualtinok

scripts.build: bun ../../scripts/check-bun.mjs && tsc -p ../retina-local-fs/tsconfig.build.json && bun run build:tui && bun ../../scripts/clean-dist-chunks.mjs dist index.js transformers-web.js transformers-node-wasm.js && bun build src/features/magic-context/memory/transformers-web-entry.ts --outfile dist/transformers-web.js --target browser --format esm --external onnxruntime-web && bun scripts/build-transformers-node-wasm.ts dist && bun build src/index.ts src/features/magic-context/memory/embedding-worker.ts src/features/magic-context/migration-worker.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming '[name].[ext]' --target node --format esm --splitting --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external onnxruntime-node --external onnxruntime-web --external sharp --external bun:sqlite --external node:sqlite && bun run build:v2 && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.build:v2: bun ../../scripts/clean-dist-chunks.mjs dist/v2 server.js embedding-worker.js migration-worker.js && bun build src/features/magic-context/memory/transformers-web-entry.ts --outfile dist/v2/transformers-web.js --target browser --format esm --external onnxruntime-web && bun scripts/build-transformers-node-wasm.ts dist/v2 && bun build src/v2/server.ts src/features/magic-context/memory/embedding-worker.ts src/features/magic-context/migration-worker.ts --outdir dist/v2 --entry-naming '[name].[ext]' --target node --format esm --splitting --external @opencode/plugin --external onnxruntime-node --external onnxruntime-web --external sharp --external bun:sqlite --external node:sqlite && bun test src/v2/server.test.ts
scripts.check:tui-compiled: bun run build:tui && git diff --exit-code -- src/tui-compiled && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- src/tui-compiled)"
scripts.test: bun ../../scripts/check-bun.mjs && bun install --frozen-lockfile && BUN_JSC_useOMGJIT=0 bun test --parallel=4 --timeout 30000
scripts.clean: bun ../../scripts/clean-dist-chunks.mjs dist index.js embedding-worker.js migration-worker.js transformers-web.js transformers-node-wasm.js && bun ../../scripts/clean-dist-chunks.mjs dist/v2 server.js embedding-worker.js migration-worker.js transformers-web.js transformers-node-wasm.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun run build:tui

//test: Only test runs disable JSC's optimizing WebAssembly tier so per-file isolation does not pay its compilation cost on every file. This is not a production setting and does not change host process engine options.
